- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Advent wreath typically has four candles, one for each Sunday in Advent, and a fifth candle, the Christ candle.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The significance of the Advent procession lies in preparation, repentance, and anticipation of Jesus' coming.
